name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions:
1. Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar. Plant feet flat on the floor.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Retract and depress your shoulder blades.
3. Unrack the bar and position it over your mid-chest with arms locked.
4. Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, touching lightly.
5. Press the bar back up in a slight arc toward the rack position until arms are fully extended.
cues: Retract shoulder blades and arch upper back
Drive feet into floor for leg drive
Bar path: slight diagonal from chest to lockout

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions:
1. Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Sit with dumbbells on thighs.
2. Kick dumbbells up one at a time as you lie back. Start with arms extended.
3. Lower the dumbbells to chest level with elbows at 45 degrees.
4. Press back up, squeezing the chest at the top.
5. At the end of the set, bring dumbbells to thighs and sit up safely.
cues: Keep wrists neutral and stacked over elbows

name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat, press dumbbells from chest to lockout with controlled tempo.

name: Cable Fly
instructions:
1. Set cables at chest height and stand in the center with a staggered stance.
2. Grab handles and step forward to create tension, arms extended to sides.
3. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
4. Bring hands together in a wide arc motion, squeezing chest at the center.
5. Slowly open arms back to the stretched position under control.
cues: Maintain slight bend in elbows - do not straighten arms
Squeeze and hold pecs at the center for 1 second

name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Set bench at incline between low cables. Fly upward to target upper chest.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean forward on dip bars, lower until shoulders below elbows, press up.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit with back flat, press handles forward to lockout.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, lower chest to floor, push up.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Sit upright, bring pads together by squeezing chest.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Press barbell end upward and forward in an arc from chest.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, bar over mid-foot.
2. Hinge at hips and grip bar just outside knees (double overhand or mixed grip).
3. Drop hips, brace core hard, pull slack out of the bar.
4. Drive through the floor, keeping bar close to shins. Hips and shoulders rise together.
5. Lock out by squeezing glutes and standing tall. Lower under control.
cues: Brace core like you're about to get punched
Bar drags along your legs the entire lift
Hips and shoulders rise at the same rate

name: Barbell Row
instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hinge at hips to roughly 45 degrees.
2. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width with overhand grip.
3. Brace core and maintain flat back throughout the movement.
4. Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, leading with elbows.
5. Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top, then lower under control.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades at the top for 1 second
Keep torso angle constant - no jerking upright

name: Pull-Up
instructions:
1. Grip the bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder width, overhand grip.
2. Hang with arms fully extended, depress and retract shoulder blades.
3. Pull yourself up by driving elbows down toward your hips.
4. Continue until chin clears the bar, pause briefly.
5. Lower yourself under control to full arm extension.
cues: Initiate by depressing shoulders, not bending arms
Drive elbows down and back like you're putting them in your pockets
Full dead hang at bottom, chin over bar at top

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with underhand grip, pull chin above bar.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions:
1. Sit with thighs secured under pads, grip bar wider than shoulder width.
2. Lean back slightly (10-15 degrees) and lift your chest.
3. Pull the bar down to your upper chest/collarbone area.
4. Squeeze your lats at the bottom, holding for a brief pause.
5. Control the bar back up, feeling a full stretch in your lats.
cues: Lean back slightly and lift chest
Pull to collarbone, not behind the neck
Feel the stretch at the top of each rep

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions:
1. Sit with feet on the foot plates, knees slightly bent.
2. Grip the handle with arms fully extended, chest up and back straight.
3. Pull the handle toward your abdomen, driving elbows straight back.
4. Squeeze shoulder blades together at the peak for 1 second.
5. Slowly extend arms back to the start, feeling the lat stretch.
cues: Keep chest up and do not round lower back
Allow a slight stretch forward but maintain neutral spine

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions:
1. Place one knee and same-side hand on a flat bench for support.
2. Hold dumbbell in the other hand with arm fully extended.
3. Keep back flat and parallel to the floor, brace core.
4. Row the dumbbell up toward your hip, driving elbow straight back.
5. Lower under control to full arm extension and repeat.
cues: Drive elbow back toward the ceiling
Keep hips square - do not rotate torso
Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle bar, row T-bar handle to chest.

name: Face Pull
instructions:
1. Set cable to upper chest height with rope attachment.
2. Grip rope with thumbs pointing back, step back to create tension.
3. Pull rope toward your face, splitting the rope apart.
4. Externally rotate shoulders so hands end up beside your ears.
5. Squeeze rear delts and hold for 1 second before returning.
cues: Elbows stay high throughout the movement
Externally rotate at the finish - hands end up by ears
Light weight, focus on contraction, not ego

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Keep arms straight, pull bar down from overhead to thighs.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set barbell at knee height in rack, deadlift from there.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to landmine, row end of barbell with one arm.

name: Overhead Press
instructions:
1. Unrack bar to front rack position, hands just outside shoulders.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, brace core and squeeze glutes.
3. Press bar straight up, moving your head back slightly to clear.
4. Lock out arms overhead, push head through so bar is over mid-foot.
5. Lower bar under control back to front rack position.
cues: Brace core and squeeze glutes throughout
Push head through at lockout so bar is balanced over spine
Elbows slightly in front of the bar at the start

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions:
1. Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
2. Brace core and maintain a neutral spine - avoid excessive arching.
3. Press both dumbbells overhead simultaneously until arms are fully extended.
4. Bring dumbbells slightly together at the top.
5. Lower under control back to shoulder height.
cues: Do not arch your lower back excessively
Full lockout overhead with arms extended
Controlled tempo both up and down

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you, rotate as you press overhead.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions:
1. Stand with dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in elbows.
2. Raise arms out to the sides, leading with elbows not hands.
3. Lift until arms are parallel with the floor (or slightly below).
4. Hold briefly at the top, feeling the medial delt contraction.
5. Lower under control - do not just drop the weight.
cues: Slight forward lean and pour water from a pitcher
Use a controlled tempo - no swinging or momentum

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside cable, raise arm to shoulder height.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend forward, raise dumbbells out to sides.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells in front to shoulder height.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Pull bar up close to body to chin level.
cues: Don't go above chin if painful

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright, press handles overhead.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Face the pad, push handles back to target rear delts.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions:
1. Stand upright with shoulder-width grip on the barbell, arms extended.
2. Pin elbows to your sides - they should not move forward or back.
3. Curl the bar up by flexing at the elbow, squeezing your biceps.
4. Pause briefly at the top when forearms are vertical.
5. Lower the bar under control for a 2-3 second negative.
cues: Keep elbows pinned to your sides throughout

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions:
1. Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward (supinated grip).
2. Keep elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.
3. Curl both dumbbells up simultaneously, squeezing biceps.
4. Pause at the top when forearms are vertical.
5. Lower under control to full arm extension.
cues: Full range of motion - full extension to full contraction

name: Hammer Curl
instructions:
1. Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing each other (neutral grip).
2. Keep elbows pinned to sides throughout the movement.
3. Curl both dumbbells up simultaneously, maintaining neutral grip.
4. Squeeze at the top when forearms are roughly vertical.
5. Lower under control to full arm extension.
cues: Neutral grip targets brachialis and forearms
Keep wrists locked - do not rotate
Alternate arms if needed for heavier weights

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, curl dumbbells with stretch at bottom.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest arms on preacher pad, curl bar up.

name: Cable Curl
instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar or EZ bar to a low pulley.
2. Stand facing the cable, grip the bar with arms extended.
3. Pin elbows to your sides and curl the bar up by flexing biceps.
4. Squeeze at the top for 1 second.
5. Lower under control back to full extension, feeling constant tension.
cues: Constant tension throughout - no slack at any point
Squeeze and hold at the top

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on bench, brace elbow against inner thigh, curl.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie chest-down on incline bench, curl bar.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions:
1. Stand facing cable machine with straight bar or V-bar attachment.
2. Grip the attachment with hands shoulder-width apart, elbows at sides.
3. Push the attachment down by extending your elbows fully.
4. Squeeze triceps hard at the bottom for a brief pause.
5. Allow the weight to pull your forearms back up to about 90 degrees.
cues: Pin elbows to your sides - they should not move
Squeeze and hold at full extension
Do not lean into the weight

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions:
1. Attach rope to low pulley. Face away from the machine, step forward.
2. Hold rope overhead with elbows close to your head.
3. Allow the weight to pull your forearms back, getting a deep stretch.
4. Extend arms overhead by straightening elbows, squeezing triceps.
5. Slowly return to the stretched position, keeping elbows stationary.
cues: Keep elbows close to your head throughout
Feel a deep stretch at the bottom - this targets the long head

name: Skull Crusher
instructions:
1. Lie on flat bench holding EZ bar with narrow grip, arms extended above chest.
2. Keep upper arms vertical and stationary throughout.
3. Lower the bar by bending only at the elbows, toward your forehead.
4. Stop just before the bar reaches your forehead or slightly behind.
5. Extend elbows to press bar back to starting position.
cues: Upper arms stay vertical - only elbows bend
Control the descent - do not actually crush your skull
Slight backward angle targets the long head better

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Bench press with hands shoulder-width apart.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, extend arm behind you.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Push-up with hands forming a diamond shape.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Upright torso on dip bars, lower and press up.

name: Rope Pushdown
instructions: Push rope down and split at bottom.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearms on bench, curl wrists up.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearms on bench palms down, extend wrists up.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides, walk for distance or time.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions:
1. Position bar on upper back (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Grip tightly.
2. Unrack and step back. Feet shoulder-width or slightly wider, toes angled out 15-30 degrees.
3. Take a deep breath, brace core hard, and begin descent by breaking at hips and knees simultaneously.
4. Descend until hip crease is at or below the top of the knee (parallel or below).
5. Drive up through mid-foot, keeping chest up and knees tracking over toes.
cues: Big breath and brace before every rep
Knees track over toes - push them out
Chest up, eyes forward, drive through mid-foot

name: Front Squat
instructions:
1. Position bar on front delts in a clean grip or cross-arm grip.
2. Keep elbows high throughout to prevent the bar from rolling forward.
3. Unrack and set feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
4. Squat down keeping torso as vertical as possible, elbows high.
5. Drive up through mid-foot maintaining an upright torso.
cues: Elbows high - if they drop, the bar falls forward
Core stays braced throughout the entire lift

name: Leg Press
instructions:
1. Sit in the machine with back and head flat against the pad.
2. Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, about halfway up.
3. Release the safeties and lower the platform by bending knees.
4. Descend until knees reach approximately 90 degrees (do not let lower back round).
5. Press through your whole foot to extend legs, stopping just short of lockout.
cues: Do not lock knees at the top
Keep lower back pressed against the pad
Foot placement higher targets glutes, lower targets quads

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Back against pad, squat down and drive up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions:
1. Sit in the machine with back against the pad, knees at 90 degrees.
2. Adjust the pad so it sits on your lower shins, just above the ankles.
3. Extend your legs by contracting your quads until legs are straight.
4. Pause and squeeze quads hard at the top for 1-2 seconds.
5. Lower the weight slowly under control back to the starting position.
cues: Pause and squeeze at full extension
Do not use momentum to swing the weight

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions:
1. Stand about 2 feet in front of a bench, place the top of one foot on it.
2. Hold dumbbells at your sides or a single dumbbell goblet-style.
3. Lower your body by bending the front knee until thigh is parallel.
4. Keep torso upright and front knee tracking over toes.
5. Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
cues: Front knee tracks over toes - do not let it cave in
All the drive comes from the front leg

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into lunge, alternate legs.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat deep.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back in Smith machine, squat.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Lean back, bend knees forward, isolating quads.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto elevated platform, drive through heel.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding barbell at hip level with overhand grip.
2. Maintain a slight bend in knees - this stays constant throughout.
3. Push hips straight back, lowering the bar along your thighs and shins.
4. Descend until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings (typically mid-shin).
5. Drive hips forward to return to standing, squeezing glutes at the top.
cues: Push hips back like closing a car door with your butt
Bar stays in contact with legs the entire time
This is a hinge, not a squat - knees barely bend

name: Leg Curl
instructions:
1. Lie face down on the leg curl machine, pad against lower calves.
2. Grip handles and keep hips pressed into the pad.
3. Curl the pad toward your glutes by bending at the knees.
4. Squeeze hamstrings at the peak contraction for 1 second.
5. Lower the weight slowly under control to near-full extension.
cues: Keep hips pressed down - do not let them rise
Squeeze and hold at the top

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine, curl pad under thighs.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Deadlift with minimal knee bend, emphasizing hamstring stretch.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge with dumbbells along thighs.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on back, hinge forward until torso parallel.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with ankles secured, lower torso forward eccentrically.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, hinge forward while extending other leg back.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with upper back against a bench, feet flat on the floor.
2. Roll the barbell over your legs and position it in your hip crease (use a pad).
3. Plant feet firmly, approximately shoulder-width apart.
4. Drive through your heels and squeeze glutes to lift hips until fully extended.
5. Hold the top position for 1 second, then lower hips under control.
cues: Full hip extension at the top - do not hyperextend lower back
Chin tucked, look forward, not up

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Face away from cable, hinge at hips, drive hips forward.

name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kick leg back against cable resistance.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, drive hips up squeezing glutes.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Wide stance squat holding dumbbell between legs.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions:
1. Position shoulders under pads, balls of feet on the platform edge.
2. Start with heels as low as possible, getting a full calf stretch.
3. Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
4. Hold the peak contraction for 1-2 seconds.
5. Lower slowly back to the stretched position.
cues: Full range of motion - stretch at bottom, squeeze at top
Do not bounce at the bottom

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated, raise heels against resistance.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells, rise up on toes on elevated surface.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Hinge forward on machine, raise heels.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold position on forearms and toes, body straight.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at cable, crunch down bringing elbows to knees.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel or higher.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Roll wheel forward from knees, extending body, return.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with torso leaned back, rotate side to side.

name: Dead Bug

name: Pallof Press

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, alternate touching elbow to opposite knee.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: In push-up position, rapidly alternate driving knees to chest.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Hold side position on one forearm, body straight.

name: Woodchop
instructions: Rotate cable from high to low diagonally across body.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on bench, grip behind head, raise body off bench keeping straight.

name: Decline Crunch
instructions: On decline bench, curl torso up.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles, drive up.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, grip inside knees, pull to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, shrug shoulders up.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell at thighs, shrug shoulders up.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Curl EZ bar from thighs to shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step laterally, sit into lunge, push back.

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on platform, deadlift from deficit for increased ROM.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Row from dead stop on floor each rep.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: On incline bench, curl with neutral grip.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench, lower dumbbell behind head, pull back over chest.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: High-to-low cable fly movement crossing at center.

name: Reverse Grip Barbell Row
instructions: Underhand grip barbell row to lower abdomen.

name: Standing Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Bar on back, rise on toes on elevated surface.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step backward into lunge, push back to standing.
cues: Easier on knees than forward lunge

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: On leg press, push with toes through calf raise ROM.

name: Box Squat
instructions: Squat to box, pause, explode up.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell to shoulder height.

instructions: Hold kettlebell at chest, squat deep.

instructions: Clean kettlebell to rack position, press overhead.

name: Banded Face Pull
instructions: Pull band to face, externally rotate.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Bench press on decline, targets lower chest.

name: Overhead Squat
instructions: Hold barbell overhead with wide grip while squatting.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor, press dumbbells. Floor limits ROM for tricep emphasis.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Push weighted sled for distance.

name: Battle Rope

instructions: Squat down then explode upward into jump.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Push legs apart against resistance.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under bar, pull chest to bar.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Push-up in pike position, targeting shoulders.

instructions: Against wall, lower head to floor and press up.

name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Pull-up transitioning over bar into dip position.

instructions: Kneeling lunge stretch for hip flexors.

instructions: Pull rope to face then rotate hands up.

instructions: Lie on bench, lower dumbbells in arc out to sides, bring back together.

instructions: Use V-bar attachment on lat pulldown.
